  **Conditions:** PD at Ta 25 C with RthJA 250 C/W, Note 1: device on a 1 in2 FR-4 board with 2 oz copper in still air. A test-board condition, not a measured value for the project PCB; the feature bullet "on ceramic PCB" is not used.

  **Verdict:** PASS - primary-source confirmed · **Provenance:** PRIMARY-SPEC

</EvidenceFact>

<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-c43490-thermal-screen" />

  **Fact:** `fact-c43490-thermal-screen`

  **Value:** Survey paper screen (no measured temperature): P D9 (R29+R30 1.47k) 21 V 76.523 mW, 22.56 V 88.314 mW, 28.35 V treated as continuous DC 139.463 mW; D11/D12 (4.7k) 23.934 / 27.622 / 43.619 mW. The governing D9 28.35 V stress needs an effective board theta below 788.7 C/W at 40 C ambient or 322.7 C/W at 105 C for Tj \< 150 C; 125 C ambient combined with 28.35 V continuous does not pass. The JSCJ 250 C/W is a 1 in2 / 2 oz FR-4 test-board value, not a measured value for this PCB. · **Unit:** `NONE`

  **Conditions:** Pz \<= Vs^2/(4 Rmin), Rmin = Rnom x 0.99 x 0.99 (1 % initial tolerance and 100 ppm/C over -40..125 C resistor temperature); ambient values are screening points, not a product rating. Native-PCB effective theta and product ambient remain board-level qualification gates.

  **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH · **Provenance:** PROJECT-CHOICE

  **Evidence:** [`src-c43490-primary`](#src-c43490-primary) — manufacturing/readiness/parts-sourcing-audit-20261122/details/semiconductors.json survey ledger row reviews\[code=C192739].thermal\_and\_temperature\_screen
</EvidenceFact>
